say:2:1423422001:1.text: I knew you were scheming something. Those ironhides... you did that, didn't you?
say:2:1423422001:1.source_cn: 你们果然在酝酿着什么阴谋！刚刚那些穿甲兽是不是被你们……

say:3:1423422002:1.text: They were honored to be the first to taste our new elixir. No need to act noble! You'll be joining them soon!
say:3:1423422002:1.source_cn: 它们只是光荣地成为了陨识魔药的第一批享用者！不必伪善，...

say:4:1423422003:1.text: Before long, every drop of water in Sal'thorin will be cleansed by our elixir...
say:4:1423422003:1.source_cn: 届时萨洛克兰的所有水源都会在陨识魔药的涤荡下重归纯洁……

say:5:1423422004:1.text: This land will pay for turning its back on the Queen and High Priestess!
say:5:1423422004:1.source_cn: 整个萨洛克兰都要为背叛女王和奎茵冕下的行径付出代价！

say:6:1423422005:1.text: There's no reasoning with them! We stop them here!
say:6:1423422005:1.source_cn: 跟她们根本讲不通嘛！只能在这里阻止她们了！
